categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Leary New Material Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on functional materials and their application products, including functional adhesive films, new energy coated carbon foils, and carbon nanotubes. The company serves industries such as consumer electronics, automotive electronics, new energy batteries, servers, and LED lighting. It operates through subsidiaries specializing in flexible flat cables (FFC), flexible printed circuits (FPC), and decorative films.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include adhesive formulation, precision coating, nano-composite modification, and automated production lines for functional films and flexible cables. It has proprietary processes for producing high-frequency, high-temperature resistant adhesive films, coated carbon foils with conductive nano-graphite layers, and carbon nanotube powder and conductive slurry with chlorine purification technology. The company also employs laser electrostatic printing and roll-to-roll manufacturing for LED flexible circuit boards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major electronics manufacturers such as Samsung, Foxconn, Sumitomo, and automotive companies like Geely, Nissan, Great Wall Motors, SAIC-GM-Wuling, and BAIC. The company serves the 3C electronics market (computers, communications, consumer electronics), new energy vehicles, energy storage, semiconductor, and home appliance sectors. Its products are used in high-frequency signal transmission, automotive electronics, battery packs, and LED lighting.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong, Henan, and Sichuan provinces. It has expanded its global footprint through a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong and exports products to ASEAN countries (Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia), Brazil, South Korea, Turkey, and other Belt and Road Initiative countries. It targets emerging markets in the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Leary Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing key functional materials such as adhesive films, coated carbon foils, and carbon nanotubes that serve as critical inputs for downstream manufacturers of flexible cables, battery packs, LED lighting, and electronic devices. It also integrates upstream by developing raw material formulations and downstream by producing application products like FFC cables and flexible circuit boards.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven innovation with a '1+N' collaborative R&D platform linking strategic partners to accelerate breakthroughs in new materials. It focuses on developing high-frequency, high-temperature resistant films, new energy battery materials, and carbon nanotube applications for fast-charging and solid-state batteries. R&D investments emphasize expanding product applications in automotive electronics, AI-driven servers, and energy storage, while advancing intelligent manufacturing and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of functional adhesive films, flexible flat cables (FFC), LED flexible circuit boards, and coated carbon foils. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by buyout distribution channels. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. Export sales contribute a significant portion of revenue, with contracts typically recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Leary Technology holds a leading domestic position in functional adhesive films and flexible cables, breaking international monopolies held by Japanese and Korean firms like Riken and Sumitomo. It competes in high-frequency transmission materials and new energy battery components with a strong technology and patent portfolio. The company is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and maintains competitive advantages through integrated industry chain collaboration and diversified product offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 525.6 million, a 19.95% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 37.36 million, up 27.69%. Total assets grew 23.48% to RMB 1.45 billion. R&D investment accounted for 5.62% of revenue. The company has shown steady growth driven by market expansion in functional films and coated carbon foils, with increasing cash flow from operations and ongoing capital expenditures for capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Leary Technology emphasizes its technological leadership in adhesive formulations and precision coating processes, enabling customized, high-performance functional films that meet stringent automotive and new energy battery requirements. Its products offer superior thermal stability, high-frequency signal transmission, and environmental compliance (RoHS). The company’s innovative manufacturing methods, such as laser electrostatic printing and roll-to-roll processing, provide eco-friendly, high-efficiency production with enhanced product quality and cost advantages, supporting customers’ evolving needs in emerging high-growth sectors.
